soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 / def:ling-model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The population ICA claim invokes the usual nondegenerate-source ICA theorem, but Mling permits an error coordinate with zero variance; add nonzero coordinate variances (or an equivalent nonsingularity condition) to the model class.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 / def:symmetrized-fobi-region
soundness_flags.one_line: K_m is only an informal row-direction region although it is used as a matrix-valued confidence set, and “K_m contracts to [W]_mon” specifies neither quotient normalization nor a metric; define the normalized lift, calibration, and contraction topology.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states ICA identifies the mixing matrix up to scaling and permutation, constructs cyclic-LiNG candidates by admissible zero-free-diagonal row permutations and normalization, and proves that a stable true model with disjoint cycles has at most one stable admissible candidate.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2509.21423 public version; NeurIPS 2025 primary PDF was not publicly inspectable in this review.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The public theorem text identifies valid row permutations with perfect matchings and proves SCCs remain unchanged among distribution-equivalent graphs; it does not state stability-filtered SCC factorization or stable-orbit counting complexity.
The article proves counting independent sets is #P-complete for graphs of maximum degree three, in fact for 3-regular graphs.

Theorem 2 states that, unless NP=RP, no fully polynomial approximation scheme counts independent sets on graphs of maximum degree at most d for every d at least six; this includes activity one and degree six.
The article gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for the permanent of an arbitrary nonnegative matrix.
Theorem 8 gives FOBI consistency and a root-sample-size expansion under bounded eighth moments, the paper's ICA assumptions, and ordered distinct kurtoses.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a nondegenerate-error condition to Mling and carry it explicitly through the ICA proposition and the FOBI subclass, matching the cited ICA premise.

Replace the informal FOBI region by an explicit normalized quotient confidence-set construction: state the row-scale normalization, covariance estimator, critical value, group action, and Hausdorff/projective contraction metric.

Make the analytic-homotopy OEQ auditable with one fully worked nontrivial graph instance that lists its contours, Schur complement, zero count, and exclusion of every unintended assignment before attempting the uniform proof.

recommended_next_step: Revise the ICA nondegeneracy and FOBI confidence-image definitions, then advance the concrete graph-gadget realization as the field-tier Stage 0 kernel.
